trace.name: Upper GI endoscopy: Dieulafoy lesion missed at survey

case.note: The missed-variant attempt. An incidental clean-based duodenal ulcer is found, classified Forrest III (truly, of that ulcer) and declared — and the search that this configuration exists to force (m3.3) is never made, so the actual source, a Dieulafoy lesion of the proximal stomach, is never accounted for. At the completion survey (m6.2, t=1380s) the artery declares itself: haemorrhage at the verify-flagged placeholder rate, controlled 300 s later (1500 mL), and the attempt FAILS (err.missed-variant). Management is exemplary — recognised, help called, controlled, repeat endoscopy planned at dp4 — and does not rescue the verdict. The consulted series reaches this diagnosis at first endoscopy in 85% of cases (T54); this is the other 15%.
